text:
ana: Heads-up — we got two pages last night from gpu-util spikes that lasted <2m each. They woke oncall but weren’t user-impacting. Thinking we should split paging vs ticketing for these flares.

matt: Ugh yeah saw that. Current prometheus rule checks `node_gpu_util > 0.85` with no `for`. That’ll catch every jitter.

ana: (typo) ana: ^ meant current rule has no sustained window. Proposal: only page on sustained or if pods are pending because of capacity. Short flares -> ticket. :thinking:

matt: Agreed. Two quick wins: 1) add a recording rule for 10m max and alert on that, 2) add a secondary alert that pages only when count(node_gpu_util > 0.85) by (cluster) >= 3 AND pods_pending > 0.

devon: Example prometheus alerts I’ve been testing in staging:
```yaml
# recording rule
- record: infra:sustained_gpu_util:10m
  expr: max_over_time(node_gpu_util[10m])

# page-only alert
- alert: ClusterSustainedHighGPU
  expr: infra:sustained_gpu_util:10m > 0.85
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "Sustained high GPU util in {{ $labels.cluster }}"

# ticket-only (transient) alert
- alert: TransientGPUFlare
  expr: node_gpu_util > 0.9
  for: 0m
  labels:
    severity: ticket
  annotations:
    summary: "Transient GPU spike on {{ $labels.instance }}"
```

kevin: Nice. Couple notes: group by `cluster` and `gpu_type` in alertmanager so we don’t page for a single noisy slot. Also add a mute window for scheduled batch jobs (midnight-03:00) and a short cooldown per-instance (snooze if same instance paged in last 15m).

ana: Also want tickets to auto-annotate with affected k8s namespaces and model tags if we can pull them from node labels — that speeds root cause. We should add that to the alertmanager webhook payload.

matt: Good call. For SLO tie-in: only page if the cluster sustained high util AND the infra_slo_errors:rate[5m] > 0.01 (so we catch real user impact). Otherwise route to backlog.

devon: I pushed the recording rule and a draft alert to staging earlier. SRE-bot shows success: `sre-bot: prometheus-rules: staging apply succeeded`

sre-bot: prometheus-rules: staging apply succeeded (run_id=20260318-1723)

kevin: I'll add alertmanager grouping config and the mute window next.

matt: I’ll open the PR with tests and README for runbook changes, assigning @kevin for review. If reviews go well we can promote to prod Tuesday. :thumbsup:
